evidence.summary: v0.21.1 and v0.21.2 both shipped with accurate, auto-compiled CHANGELOG.md entries; the documentation gate has not been bypassed without an audited reason since it shipped.

Final v0.25 local release audit passed under Node.js 22.19.0: 712 foundation tests, 17 legacy tests, 34 workspace package tests, builds, typechecks, formatting, source/package boundaries, planning synchronization, Changesets status, production dependency audit, 98-file AutoForge quality gate, packed artifact contents, and isolated four-package npm installation all passed. Remaining work is documentation evidence reconciliation, bounded commit review excluding claude_resume.md and .autoforge/learning/strategy.json, remote GitHub CI, and explicit release approval.

Final v0.25 release-candidate validation passed on Node 22.19.0: 712 foundation tests plus one Windows-only skip, 17 legacy tests, 34 package tests, all package build/typecheck/format tasks, source and package boundaries, Changesets status, clean public tarballs, isolated package-set install, and the explicit 102-file AutoForge security and quality gate.

The v0.25 documentation usability audit reconciled ten current guides: formatting, local links, planning synchronization, containment, secret scanning, typecheck, and tests all pass. README now provides a concise agent one-liner and docs/README.md is the maintained lifecycle walkthrough and authority map.
